general_information: The guideline discusses various aspects of aortic disease, including biomechanics, sex, race, ethnicity factors, and quality of life.
It addresses the under-representation of female patients in vascular disease studies.
The impact of marital status on postoperative quality of life is mentioned.
Endovascular repair outcomes are compared across sexes and races.
Various rehabilitation and exercise-based cardiac rehabilitation options are suggested for patients with aortic diseases.
